sentences.en: We had to gear our lives to the new circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我们必须适应新的环境。

sentences.en: When you get on the highway, shift into fifth gear.
sentences.zh: 上了高速公路后，换到五挡。

sentences.en: Want of wit is worse than want of gear.
sentences.zh: 缺乏智慧比缺乏装备更糟糕。

senses.zh: 用具，设备，衣服 - 齿轮；传动装置；(排)挡 -
